en: Dependent on a state that is neither a root nor has a limited object, there arises a state that is a root and has a limited object by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither a root nor has a sublime object, there arises a state that is a root and has a sublime object by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is neither a root nor has an immeasurable object, a state that is a root and has an immeasurable object arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.
